selection.description: Per source, SHA256(seed|URL) ordered sample of up to 8 described plus 3 index-only DC/US-remote records outside the issue5 27. Then up to 4 additional described assistant/aide/coordinator/internships/government-affairs titles per Senate/Union using issue7-transfer-17. 55 additional records; no model outputs used.
selection.limitations: Same analyst and same sources/time snapshot, not blinded or representative; holdout heavily senior, legal and index-only. Do not tune on held-out results or infer market precision.

definitions.plausible: Worth a reasonable application review; not confirmation all requirements met.
definitions.stretch: Material scope/duration/domain gaps, but credible transfer merits review.
definitions.unlikely: Substantial competitive mismatch or unrelated/specialized work.
definitions.ineligible: Stated mandatory credential/experience unsupported by documented early-career profile; not a legal eligibility determination.
definitions.unknown: Insufficient evidence of requirements or particular opportunity.
